area: Bet attributes (READ ME step 3): kind/market, league/sport, odds and cost bands, listed-EV bands, books behind the fair (cnoBooks), booksTwoSided / booksAgreeing / agreeShare, sharpVerdict, and available dollars, one at a time and in 2- and 3-way combinations, against CLV (game-clustered CI) and ROI, with the phone's own splits as a cross-check. Vigilant scan study v0.70.1: 2080 bets, 683 with a close, 69 games with a close, first looks Oct 3 17:56 ET to Oct 6 00:05 ET.
trust_notes: UNITS: every *_pct is in percentage points (CLV +1.73 = +1.73%); candidate_rules use fractions (0.0173). CIs are 95% bootstrap resamples of GAMES (shared loader, 1500-2000 draws; Monte-Carlo noise about +-0.05 points). WHAT I CAN TRUST: my loader reproduces 68 of the phone's own printed splits (bets, closes, CLV, games, beat%) to the digit (largest CLV difference 0.016 points; ROI differs up to 1.0 point only where band edges or the 9 VOID bets differ), and my CI half-widths are 0.97x the phone's (median over 58 splits). WHAT I CANNOT TRUST: (1) Only 683 of 2080 bets (33%) have a close and they come from 69 games; 501 closes are NFL props in 15 games, 536 closes are games on Oct 4. The effective sample is games, and most CLV splits rest on 15-50 games. (2) The shared date halves split by first-look day (H1 = Oct 3-4: 618 closes; H2 = Oct 5-6: only 65 closes, because the games of Oct 5-12 had not been played) so H2 cannot test CLV. I therefore ALSO split the close-bearing games by START time (T1 = games starting up to Oct 4 13:00 ET: 353 closes in 43 games; T2 = later: 330 closes in 26 games) and judged 'holds on both halves' on T1/T2 (>=30 closes each) and showed H1/H2 next to it. ROI halves use the shared first-look-day split (settled bets). Both are time splits, never random, but 'out of sample' is still the second half of about 2 days of games, under changing app versions (0.57.0 to 0.70.1) and presets. (3) CLOSE SOURCE CONFOUNDS EVERYTHING: ESPN/DraftKings closes +0.82% (97), Tracker +0.57% (228; exists only for bets Tj placed), Novig's last trades -0.23% (341; 95 of them are 1-2 trades, a price not a close), Pinnacle -0.01% (17). Props have no ESPN close, so prop CLV is mostly against Novig's own trades or Tracker price; game lines are mostly against ESPN. The listed-EV minus CLV gap is +0.17 pts on ESPN closes, -1.22 on Tracker and -2.00 on Novig trades. (4) TIME TO START CONFOUNDS EVERYTHING: bets first listed within 6h of the start have CLV +1.41% (256 closes, 66 games) and those listed more than 6h before -0.54% (427 closes, 31 games); props are listed early (69% of prop closes were first listed >6h out vs 33% of spread closes), so raw kind, league, price and 'shown' differences are largely timing and EV mixes. I report both raw and controlled (close source + time-to-start bands, with and without linear listed EV) effects with game-clustered SEs. (5) MULTIPLE COMPARISONS: about 140 one-way cuts were printed, 580 groups (nc>=40) were scanned (29 one-way, 186 two-way, 365 three-way over 9 coarse attributes; 184 have >=100 closes, 90 have >=150) and about 60 hand-chosen follow-ups were looked at: roughly 800 looks at 683 closes. A game-level sign-flip null (1000 sims) says the scan alone would give 7.3 groups with z>1.96 and >=100 closes by luck; 8 were seen. Only the time-to-start groups and NHL clear the family-wise bar in the scan (the listed-EV slope is a separate pre-specified test, z=3.4). (6) THE 'JUDGED' SET (book page read, 314 bets, 236 closes, 47 games) is the app's top-EV rows: listed EV 1.95% vs 1.10% for the rest, median 260 vs 562 minutes to the start, 65% shown vs 34%. NOTE the loader docstring is wrong: sharpVerdict NO_SHARP is also the DEFAULT for the 1442 bets with no page read (only 40 page-read bets are really NO_SHARP) and NaN means the 324 bets Vigilant's own scan listed first; 'page read' is booksTwoSided.notna(). agreeShare, booksAgreeing, booksTwoSided exist only for those 314; cnoBooks is empty for the 348 bets Vigilant's scan found. (7) ROI: 9 VOID bets count as 0 in my settled n (1705 vs the phone's 1696). ROI CIs are +-6 to +-25 points, so ROI cannot rank any group here (3 of 61 groups with >=100 settled bets have a CI off zero, about what chance gives; correlation of group ROI with group CLV 0.06 over 52 groups, with listed EV -0.09). (8) NHL games on Oct 3-5 are probably preseason (the regular season opens about Oct 7; the file does not say), so the NHL result may not carry to the regular season. (9) Same-day and same-slate bets share market moves; game clusters understate that. Leave-one-game-out and drop-top-3-games stability is reported for the main groups.
key_numbers: ALL: 2080 bets, 683 closes in 69 games, CLV +0.19% [-0.36, +0.79] (phone +0.19 +-0.58), beat the close 56%; ROI +1.58% [-2.0, +6.4] on 1705 settled; listed EV +1.22% (1.60% among the closes): the close erased 1.41 points of listed EV on average (gap -1.41, SE 0.27, 69 games).

LISTED EV IS THE ONE ATTRIBUTE THAT PREDICTS CLV: regression of CLV on listed EV over 683 closes (69 games): slope +0.66 CLV points per EV point (SE 0.195, z=3.4; 0.69, z=3.1 after controlling close source and time-to-start; 0.71, z=3.1 on close_ok only), intercept -0.87, so the break-even listed EV is about 1.3%. Slope is positive on every close source (ESPN 0.92 z=2.5, Tracker 0.75 z=2.3, Novig trades 0.71 z=2.0, Pinnacle 1.31 z=1.8 on 17 closes).

EV >= 2.5% (282 bets; 144 closes, 39 games): CLV +1.73% [+0.58, +3.07] on 144 closes in 39 games, beat the close 65%; start-time halves T1 68 closes +1.46% / T2 76 closes +1.98%; first-look-date halves H1 129 closes +1.75% / H2 15 closes +1.59%; ROI -2.9% [-16.5, +9.9] on 248 settled (noise). EV < 1.5% (1498 bets): CLV -0.32% [-0.78, +0.30] on 409 closes in 56 games. Gradient: EV>=1% +0.58, >=1.5% +0.95, >=2% +1.42, >=2.5% +1.73, >=3% +2.29, >=4% +3.37 [+0.40, +6.55] (52 closes, 22 games), >=5% +4.21 (29 closes).

EV x timing (the two attributes that matter): EV>=2.5% AND first listed within 6h of the start: 122 bets, CLV +3.01% [+1.99, +4.40] on 64 closes in 31 games, beat the close 72%; T1 +2.88 / T2 +3.09. EV<2.5% AND listed >6h before: 982 bets (47% of all), CLV -0.83% [-1.75, +0.03] on 347 closes in 31 games, beat the close 48%. EV<2.5% but within 6h: CLV +0.88% [+0.52, +1.37] on 192 closes in 59 games, beat the close 64%. EV>=2.5% but >6h: CLV +0.71% [-1.67, +2.77] on 80 closes in 21 games, beat the close 59%.

KIND DOES NOT PREDICT CLV once timing/EV/source are held fixed (cluster Wald p=0.996, 5 df): raw PROP +0.12 [-0.51, +0.81] (477 closes, 39 games), SPREAD +0.57 (66 closes, 43 games), TOTAL +0.44 (80/42), MONEYLINE -0.16 (32/25): every CI spans 0. Within <=6h: PROP +1.60 (149), SPREAD +1.26 (44), TOTAL +1.14 (36); within >6h: PROP -0.55 (328), SPREAD -0.79 (22), TOTAL -0.14 (44).

NHL is the only league that survives controls: CLV +1.69% [+1.06, +2.51] on 69 closes in 19 games, beat the close 71% (211 bets); start-time halves T1 18 closes +3.02% / T2 51 closes +1.22%; first-look-date halves H1 46 closes +1.74% / H2 23 closes +1.61%; controlled for close source, timing and EV +1.14 pts (z=2.85, p=0.006), family-wise p about 0.01 in the 580-group scan (0.002 among one-way splits); but all of it sits in bets the app shows (shown NHL: +4.24% on 26 closes, 16 games; hidden NHL +0.15% on 43 closes), NHL's EV slope is 1.34 vs 0.60 elsewhere, and 69 closes is below the 150-close bar. NFL -0.11 [-0.83, +0.59] on 501 closes in only 15 games; NCAAF +0.63 on 53 closes (T1 only).

PRICE: CLV falls with price (cost, = implied probability): -0.67 points per +0.10 of cost (z=-3.0 raw; -0.41, z=-1.8 after EV/timing/source). Cost .45-.48 (+108 to +122): +1.06% [+0.11, +2.30] on 190 closes, 48 games, both halves positive, but family-wise p 0.34 and z=1.3 after EV control (it is a higher-EV band: 1.80 vs 1.12 for .48-.50). Cost >= .55 (about -122 or shorter): -1.02% [-1.98, +0.24] on 64 closes in 27 games, beat the close 39%; cost >= .65: -1.7% on 19 closes, beat 14-20%. Only 57 closes lie outside -150..+150, so favourites and longshots cannot be judged.

BOOKS BEHIND THE FAIR do not help: slope per book +0.02 pts (z=0.2 after controls, -0.06 z=-0.9 raw; 505 closes, 60 games); 4-5 books +1.40% [+0.21, +3.11] (58 closes), 8-9 +0.96, 10-11 -0.08, 12+ +0.02 (201 closes), 1-3 books -2.24% (13 closes only). More books is not better.

BOOK-PAGE SET ONLY (314 bets, 236 closes, 47 games): every two-sided book agrees (agreeShare 100%): CLV +1.11% [+0.13, +2.05] on 142 closes in 40 games, beat the close 67%; raw gap to the other judged bets +1.27 [+0.11, +2.34] (142 vs 94 closes) but +0.48 (SE 0.69, z=0.7) after EV, timing and source. Sharp verdict PASSED CLV +0.80% [+0.02, +1.60] on 153 closes in 40 games, beat the close 65% vs VETOED CLV -0.10% [-1.32, +1.17] on 58 closes in 25 games, beat the close 53%; PASSED minus VETOED +0.90 [-0.44, +2.12] (153 vs 58 closes); after controls PASSED is -0.42 (SE 1.25) vs page-read NO_SHARP. The sharp book's own edge, check EV, dissent count and agreeing count add nothing after EV (all |z|<1.1).

AVAILABLE DOLLARS: no relation to CLV (<$25 -0.06, $25-100 +0.58, $100-500 +0.34, $500-2000 -0.30, $2000+ +0.36; block Wald p=0.85; slope per log10 dollar -0.12, SE 0.33). Liquidity-weighted CLV (weights min(available, cap)): cap $25 +0.19, $100 +0.21 [-0.35, +0.80], $500 +0.11 [-0.63, +0.83], against +0.19 unweighted: CLV neither holds better nor worse where there is money. Only 70% of bets have >=$25 and 43% >=$100 (median $72). Inside EV>=2.5% the edge sits in the thin books: <$100 +3.35% [+1.51, +5.43] (71 closes) vs >=$100 +0.16% [-1.16, +1.64] (73 closes), but the controlled slope within the group is not established (-1.06, SE 0.91).

SCAN BOOKKEEPING: of 580 groups (nc>=40) the observed counts with z>1.96 and >=100 closes (8 positive, 4 negative) equal what the sign-flip null gives by luck (7.3 and 7.9; P(null>=8 positive)=0.23, P(null>=4 negative)=0.37). Groups clearing nc>=150, z>1.96, both start-time halves >0 and close_ok>0: 3 (time-to-start <2h +1.42; price .45-.48 +1.06; PASSED +0.80), and the null produces 3.7 such groups on average (P(>=3)=0.25). Family-wise adjusted p: time-to-start <2h 0.003-0.01, NHL 0.01, time 2-6h 0.12, EV>=2.5% 0.22 (but EV is a pre-specified linear test, z=3.4), price .45-.48 0.34-0.45, PASSED 0.37-0.48.

findings.claim: Listed EV is real signal: the higher the EV a list showed at first look, the more the bet beat the close (slope +0.66 CLV points per EV point), but the close erases about 1.4 points of the listed EV, so the break-even listed EV is about 1.3%.
findings.evidence: OLS of CLV on listed EV with game-clustered SEs: slope 0.662 (SE 0.195, z=3.40, 69 clusters) over all 683 closes; 0.713 (SE 0.231) on close_ok; 0.686 (SE 0.223, z=3.08) with close source and time-to-start bands added; per close source ESPN 0.92 (z 2.5, 97), Tracker 0.75 (z 2.3, 228), Novig trades 0.71 (z 2.0, 341), Pinnacle 1.31 (z 1.8, 17). Mean listed EV among closes 1.60% vs mean CLV 0.19%: gap -1.41 pts (SE 0.27). Gap by time to start: first listed <=6h -0.29 (EV 1.70 -> CLV +1.41), >6h -2.08 (EV 1.54 -> -0.54). Slope by start-time half: T1 +0.45 (SE 0.34, z=1.3; 353 closes, 43 games), T2 +0.85 (SE 0.23, z=3.8; 330, 26); by first-look-day half: H1 +0.68 (z=3.3; 618 closes), H2 +0.47 (SE 0.49, z=0.9; 65 closes). Consistent with Presets.kt's note that estimated edges shrink about 1.5 points.
findings.effect: slope +0.66 per EV point (SE 0.195); intercept -0.87; gap CLV-EV -1.41 (SE 0.27)
findings.luck_risk: Low: a single pre-specified linear test, z=3.4 (p about 0.0007), positive on all four close sources and on both time halves of the data.

findings.claim: EV >= 2.5% bets beat the close by about +1.7% and hold on both halves; EV < 1.5% bets do not beat it.
findings.evidence: EV>=2.5%: 282 bets, 144 closes, 39 games, CLV +1.73% [+0.58, +3.07] on 144 closes in 39 games, beat the close 65%; start-time halves T1 68 closes +1.46% / T2 76 closes +1.98%; first-look-date halves H1 129 closes +1.75% / H2 15 closes +1.59%; close_ok +1.85 on 112. Leave-one-game-out range +1.42 to +2.04; dropping the 3 most influential games leaves +1.04 on 123 closes. EV<1.5%: 1498 bets, -0.32 [-0.78,+0.30], 409 closes, 56 games. ROI of EV>=2.5% is -2.9% [-16.5,+9.9] over 248 settled: far too wide to confirm or refute a 1.7% edge. Shown subset (EV>=2.5% and shown by the app): 242 bets, 140 closes, +1.76% [+0.55,+3.07].
findings.effect: CLV +1.73% [+0.58, +3.07] on 144 closes in 39 games, beat the close 65%
findings.luck_risk: The 2.5% cut was picked from a gradient, so treat the threshold as approximate; the gradient itself is the robust part (adjusted p for this single cut about 0.2 in the 580-group scan, but the linear EV test has p about 0.0007). The Safe-CLV preset already floors the auto-bet at 2.5%.

findings.claim: The EV effect is concentrated in bets first listed within 6h of the start: EV>=2.5% AND <=6h out has CLV about +3.0%; EV>=2.5% listed more than 6h out is indistinguishable from 0.
findings.evidence: EV>=2.5% & <=6h: 122 bets, CLV +3.01% [+1.99, +4.40] on 64 closes in 31 games, beat the close 72%; T1 +2.88 (25) / T2 +3.09 (39); H1 +2.70 (52) / H2 +4.35 (12). EV>=2.5% & >6h: 160 bets, CLV +0.71% [-1.67, +2.77] on 80 closes in 21 games, beat the close 59%. EV<2.5% & <=6h: CLV +0.88% [+0.52, +1.37] on 192 closes in 59 games, beat the close 64%. EV<2.5% & >6h: 982 bets, CLV -0.83% [-1.75, +0.03] on 347 closes in 31 games, beat the close 48%. Timing is another analyst's slice; it is reported here because it changes every attribute comparison.
findings.effect: CLV +3.01% [+1.99, +4.40] on 64 closes in 31 games, beat the close 72%; halves are thin: T1 25 closes, T2 39; H1 52, H2 12
findings.luck_risk: Moderate: a 2-way cell picked after seeing the data (one of about 20 EV x timing cells); the timing main effect itself is family-wise significant (p about 0.003); 64 closes in 31 games is under the 150-close bar.

findings.claim: Listing time confounds kind, league and price: within the same time-to-start stratum, PROP, SPREAD and TOTAL look alike.
findings.evidence: Within <=6h: PROP CLV +1.60% [+1.09, +2.48] on 149 closes in 35 games, beat the close 62%; SPREAD CLV +1.26% [+0.65, +1.84] on 44 closes in 32 games, beat the close 73%; TOTAL CLV +1.14% [-0.08, +2.41] on 36 closes in 26 games, beat the close 72%. Within >6h: PROP CLV -0.55% [-1.64, +0.44] on 328 closes in 24 games, beat the close 50%; SPREAD CLV -0.79% [-2.46, +0.59] on 22 closes in 16 games, beat the close 45%; TOTAL CLV -0.14% [-1.50, +1.44] on 44 closes in 22 games, beat the close 48%. Time-to-start bands: <30m +1.36 (89 closes), 30m-2h +1.49 (74), 2-6h +1.40 (93), 6-24h -0.37 (412 closes, 31 games), 24h+ -5.07 (15 closes, 5 games). 69% of prop closes were first listed >6h out vs 33% of spread closes.
findings.effect: <=6h CLV +1.41 (256 closes, 66 games, SE 0.26); >6h -0.54 (427 closes, 31 games, SE 0.47)
findings.luck_risk: Low for the timing effect (family-wise p about 0.003, controlled z=3.3); the 6-24h and 24h+ negatives rest on 31 and 5 games.

findings.claim: No kind of bet is distinguishable from zero or from another kind; the phone's apparent kind ranking (spreads +0.57, props +0.12, moneylines -0.16) is within noise and is timing/EV mix.
findings.evidence: PROP: CLV +0.12% [-0.51, +0.81] on 477 closes in 39 games, beat the close 54%; SPREAD: CLV +0.57% [-0.19, +1.20] on 66 closes in 43 games, beat the close 64%; TOTAL: CLV +0.44% [-0.67, +1.62] on 80 closes in 42 games, beat the close 59%; MONEYLINE: CLV -0.16% [-1.31, +1.00] on 32 closes in 25 games, beat the close 56%; PERIOD: CLV -0.19% [-2.05, +1.51] on 10 closes in 9 games, beat the close 70%; TEAM_TOTAL: CLV +0.47% [-2.98, +3.98] on 18 closes in 13 games, beat the close 56%. 'OTHER' (14 bets, 3-way soccer moneylines) has no close. Block Wald test of the kind dummies after close source + time-to-start + listed EV: chi2=0.38, 5 df, p=0.996; without the EV control p=0.75. ROI by kind (settled): PROP +3.2%, SPREAD -15.1% [-30.9,+1.5], TOTAL +12.9%, MONEYLINE -26.2% [-51.3,-1.1] on 33 bets, TEAM_TOTAL -27.8%: none is a reliable ROI signal (CI +-15 to +-25 points).
findings.effect: all kind CIs include 0; Wald p=0.996
findings.luck_risk: A 'no difference' result: power to see a 1-point kind gap is low (CI half-widths 0.7 to 3 points), so it says kind is not a large effect, not that it is zero.

findings.claim: Market strings: a few prop markets stand out (Shots On Goal, Rushing Attempts positive; Receptions, Touchdowns negative) but each rests on 9-16 games and none holds the 150-close bar.
findings.evidence: Shots On Goal (NHL) CLV +2.74% [+1.47, +4.24] on 24 closes in 16 games, beat the close 79% (81 bets); Rushing Attempts CLV +2.82% [+1.07, +4.99] on 27 closes in 11 games, beat the close 67%; Receptions CLV -1.42% [-3.19, +0.34] on 81 closes in 15 games, beat the close 51%; Touchdowns CLV -0.69% [-1.93, +1.07] on 26 closes in 9 games, beat the close 35%; Receiving Yards CLV -0.47% [-1.86, +0.67] on 124 closes in 15 games, beat the close 48%; Rushing Yards CLV -0.22% [-2.32, +1.57] on 55 closes in 15 games, beat the close 56%; Passing Yards CLV +0.80% [-0.86, +2.19] on 21 closes in 10 games, beat the close 48%; Point Spread CLV +0.39% [-0.43, +1.12] on 50 closes in 28 games, beat the close 62%; Total Points CLV +0.27% [-0.85, +1.49] on 59 closes in 27 games, beat the close 56%; Moneyline CLV -0.16% [-1.31, +1.00] on 32 closes in 25 games, beat the close 56%. Market dummies after controls: Wald p=0.028 (8 df) but driven by those thin cells. 'Receiving Yards' (289 bets) pools the CNO name 'Player Receiving Yards' and Vigilant's own 'Receiving Yards'.
findings.luck_risk: High: about 13 market cells, 9-16 games each; a market needs >=150 closes (about 40+ games) before it is a rule.

findings.claim: NHL beats the close (+1.7%) after controls, the only league effect that does; it is a lead, not a rule.
findings.evidence: NHL: 211 bets, CLV +1.69% [+1.06, +2.51] on 69 closes in 19 games, beat the close 71%; start-time halves T1 18 closes +3.02% / T2 51 closes +1.22%; first-look-date halves H1 46 closes +1.74% / H2 23 closes +1.61%. Controlled for close source, time-to-start and EV: +1.14 pts (z=2.85, p=0.006; +1.20 z=2.88 without EV). Family-wise p about 0.01 (580-group scan, groups with >=60 closes), 0.002 among the 29 one-way groups. Leave-one-game-out +1.57 to +1.87; drop top 3 games +1.45 (52 closes). Within NHL: shown +4.24% [+3.05,+5.66] (26 closes, 16 games) vs hidden +0.15% (43 closes, 13 games); EV slope 1.34 (z=3.8) vs 0.60 outside NHL; closes are Tracker 28, ESPN 29 (moneyline -1.2 on 13, puck line +1.2 on 8, totals +0.9 on 8), Novig trades 10, Pinnacle 2. By market: Shots On Goal +2.74 (24), Team Total Goals +4.6 (7), Puck Line +1.2 (8), Total Goals +0.9 (8), Moneyline -1.2 (13). Likely preseason (Oct 3-5).
findings.effect: CLV +1.69% [+1.06, +2.51] on 69 closes in 19 games, beat the close 71%
findings.luck_risk: Low-moderate: 1 of 5 leagues examined; the family-wise p is about 0.01 but 19 games and a probable preseason window; needs about 100 closes in 40+ regular-season games to become a rule.

findings.claim: NFL props, the bulk of the data (501 closes in 15 games), sit at zero CLV; NCAAF's +0.63 is Oct 3 games only and does not survive timing control.
findings.evidence: NFL: CLV -0.11% [-0.83, +0.59] on 501 closes in 15 games, beat the close 52%; start-time halves T1 275 closes +0.30% / T2 226 closes -0.62%; first-look-date halves H1 479 closes -0.03% / H2 22 closes -1.93%. NCAAF: CLV +0.63% [-0.36, +1.36] on 53 closes in 20 games, beat the close 68%; T2 has no NCAAF closes. NCAAF after timing/source control -1.15 (z=-2.3), after EV too -0.62 (z=-1.3). MLB -0.05 (27 closes, 5 games), WNBA +0.58 (19 closes, 2 games), NBA +3.74 (7 closes, 3 games), tennis +0.22 (7): too thin. Sport-level block Wald after controls p=0.029 (5 df), league p=0.137 (5 df).
findings.effect: CLV -0.11% [-0.83, +0.59] on 501 closes in 15 games, beat the close 52%
findings.luck_risk: NFL's zero is measured on 15 games with a close (30 games in all); its CI is +-0.7 points. Other leagues are too thin.

findings.claim: Heavy favourites (cost >= .55, about -122 or shorter) lose to the close: a trap, though thin.
findings.evidence: cost>=.55 rule: 467 bets, 64 closes in 27 games, CLV -1.02% [-1.98,+0.24], beat 39%; T1 -0.56 (32) / T2 -1.48 (32); H1 -1.57 (50) / H2 +0.97 (14). cost .65-.80: -1.55 (14 closes, beat 14%), >.80: -2.07 (5 closes). Controlled effect of cost>.55: -1.22 pts (z=-2.6; with EV control -0.87, z=-1.9, p=0.06). The CLV-EV gap is worse for favourites (-1.91, SE 0.56 for >.55; -2.6 to -3.1 for >.65). By source: Novig trades -1.57 (31 closes, beat 29%), ESPN -0.51 (12), Tracker -0.51 (14). NFL bets (almost all props) with cost>.55: -1.42 (44 closes, 12 games, beat 30%). ROI of these 467 bets is -2.1% [-8.3,+4.7]: no ROI signal either way.
findings.luck_risk: Moderate: z about -2 on 64 closes, one of 6 price bands, family-wise p about 0.5 in the scan. Closes for favourites exist mainly from Novig trades (a price, not a Pinnacle close). Settling it needs about 150 favourite closes (about 90 more) with a Pinnacle/ESPN close.

findings.claim: Price band .45-.48 (American +108 to +122) looks best raw (+1.06%) and holds on both halves, but most of it is a higher-EV mix and it does not pass the multiple-comparison bar; the neighbouring near-even band .48-.50 (+100 to +108) is -0.30%.
findings.evidence: .45-.48: 450 bets, CLV +1.06% [+0.11, +2.30] on 190 closes in 48 games, beat the close 65%; .48-.50 (494 bets): CLV -0.30% [-0.96, +0.35] on 217 closes in 40 games, beat the close 53%; .40-.45: +0.77 (92 closes); .50-.55 -0.01 (101 closes); <=.40: -1.17 (20 closes, 17 games). Controlled for source+timing: +1.15 (z=2.2); adding EV: +0.56 (z=1.3). Family-wise p 0.34-0.45 in the scan. .48-.50 is the most populated band (494 bets) and its listed EV is lower (1.12% vs 1.80%). American-odds bands: +111..+120 +1.22% [+0.25,+2.60] (161 closes), +100..+104 -0.20 (138), +105..+110 -0.41 (94), -150..-112 0.00 (65).
findings.luck_risk: High-moderate: p_adj 0.34; band edges matter (+1.28 on 182 closes if the edges are [.45,.48)); the effect shrinks by half once EV is controlled.

findings.claim: More books behind the fair does not mean better CLV; there is no monotone relation.
findings.evidence: cnoBooks bands: 1-3 -2.24 [-6.88,+0.62] (13 closes, 8 games), 4-5 +1.40 [+0.21,+3.11] (58, 25), 6-7 +0.60 (81, 27), 8-9 +0.96 (75, 30), 10-11 -0.08 [-0.81,+0.66] (77, 31), 12+ +0.02 [-0.57,+0.59] (201, 48), no CNO fair (Vigilant-scan bets) -0.22 (178, 30). Slope per extra book -0.058 (SE 0.064) raw and +0.017 (SE 0.075, z=0.2) with EV/timing/source on 505 closes (60 games); block Wald p=0.33-0.39. Raw slope by start-time half: T1 +0.04 (z=0.4, 259 closes, 40 games), T2 -0.18 (z=-1.9, 246 closes, 20 games): no consistent relation. ROI is highest at 8-9 (+15.9% [+4.3,+27.4]) and 10-11 (+21.2% [+7.6,+34.9]) books, where CLV is +0.96 and -0.08: a result-luck pattern, not an edge. Within the page-read set the slope is -0.13 per book (z=-1.4).
findings.effect: slope +0.02 pts per book (z=0.2); CLV by band spans -2.24 to +1.40
findings.luck_risk: The 4-5 book and 1-3 book cells are small-sample; the null slope is the robust part (no consistent sign across the two start-time halves).

findings.claim: Book-check agreement (agreeShare 100%) goes with CLV +1.1% raw, but the association is EV/timing mix, and only 314 top-EV bets were ever page-read.
findings.evidence: Judged set only (314 bets, 236 closes, 47 games): agreeShare 100% (177 bets): CLV +1.11% [+0.13, +2.05] on 142 closes in 40 games, beat the close 67%; 50-99% (100 bets): CLV -0.06% [-1.10, +0.97] on 80 closes in 31 games, beat the close 52%; <50% (31 bets): CLV -0.46% [-1.84, +1.32] on 12 closes in 10 games, beat the close 50%. 100% minus rest: +1.27 [+0.11,+2.34] (142 vs 94 closes); controlled +0.48 (SE 0.69). Dissenting books (twoSided minus agreeing): 0 -> +1.05 [+0.08,+2.00] (144 closes), 1 -> -0.61 (61), 2+ -> +0.88 (31): non-monotone; controlled slope +0.11 per dissenter (SE 0.17). booksAgreeing 0-2 +1.12 (26 closes), 3-4 +0.86 (72), 5-6 +1.06 (71), 7+ -0.37 (67); booksTwoSided 0-3 +1.62 (47), 4-5 +0.56, 6-7 +0.61, 8+ -0.10 (65): none monotone. agreeShare, booksAgreeing and booksTwoSided are null for the other 1766 bets, so none of this can be applied to the wide-read finds.
findings.effect: 100% agree +1.11 [+0.13,+2.05] (142 closes, 40 games); not significant after controls
findings.luck_risk: High: 4-5 cuts on a 236-close set; the selection (top-EV rows) is itself correlated with EV and recency. Do not use as a rule.

findings.claim: The sharp-book verdict separates bets by only +0.9 points (PASSED vs VETOED), not distinguishable from zero, and vanishes after EV control.
findings.evidence: PASSED (197 bets): CLV +0.80% [+0.02, +1.60] on 153 closes in 40 games, beat the close 65%; VETOED (77): CLV -0.10% [-1.32, +1.17] on 58 closes in 25 games, beat the close 53%; page-read NO_SHARP (40): CLV +0.96% [-1.70, +3.45] on 25 closes in 19 games, beat the close 52%; no page read (1766): CLV -0.02% [-0.72, +0.77] on 447 closes in 63 games, beat the close 53%. PASSED minus VETOED +0.90 [-0.44,+2.12] (153 vs 58 closes); PASSED minus every other close +0.79 [-0.46,+1.80]. Judged bets excluding VETOED: +0.83% [0.00,+1.62] on 178 closes (44 games) vs VETOED -0.10 (58, 25 games). After EV, timing and source: PASSED -0.42 (SE 1.25) and VETOED -0.29 (SE 1.07) against NO_SHARP. By sharpBook: Caesars +3.95 [+2.59,+5.40] (17 closes, 14 games, 88% beat, both halves +3.1/+4.7), ProphetX +0.86 (91, 19 games), Pinnacle +0.58 (27), FanDuel +1.15 (14), Kalshi -0.95 [-2.30,+0.38] (59, 21 games; T1 -0.63, T2 -1.15). Phone's ROI for PASSED +4.3%, VETOED -2.5%: within noise.
findings.luck_risk: High-moderate: PASSED z=1.96 is p_adj 0.37-0.48 in the scan; Caesars is 17 closes. The verdict's selection (top-EV rows read first) is a bias; the veto did not hurt (VETOED bets are no better than PASSED) but the data cannot show it helps.

findings.claim: Dollars available at the price do not change CLV; the edge is not concentrated where there is more money to bet.
findings.effect: no gradient; liquidity-weighted CLV +0.21 [-0.35,+0.80] vs +0.19 unweighted
findings.luck_risk: The 'thin books carry the edge' pattern inside EV>=2.5% is one 2-way cut (p_adj about 0.3); treat as a question, not a finding.

findings.claim: What the app's screen buys is its EV floor: shown bets beat the close (+0.57%) and hidden ones do not (-0.30%), but the gap vanishes once listed EV is controlled.
findings.evidence: shown (803 bets): CLV +0.57% [-0.20, +1.38] on 384 closes in 60 games, beat the close 59%; hidden (1277): CLV -0.30% [-0.82, +0.35] on 299 closes in 49 games, beat the close 52%. Listed EV: shown 2.31% vs hidden 0.54%. Controlled shown effect: +1.16 pts (z=2.6) without EV; -0.28 (z=-0.4) with EV. So the books/odds/one-way parts of the screen show no CLV benefit on their own in this data; the hidden-by-BOOKS group (147 bets, 13 closes) is -2.24 (31% beat) but too thin.
findings.effect: shown minus hidden +0.87 raw, -0.28 (z=-0.4) controlled for EV
findings.luck_risk: Moderate: depends on the linear EV control being the right form.

findings.claim: Pairs and triples add nothing beyond EV and timing: the scan finds as many 'significant' groups as luck would.
findings.evidence: 580 groups with >=40 closes (29 one-way, 186 two-way, 365 three-way; 184 with >=100 closes, 90 with >=150) over kind x league x price x EV x books x liquidity x verdict x timing x shown. Observed z>1.96 & >=100 closes: 8 positive, 4 negative; sign-flip null (1000 sims): mean 7.3 and 7.9 (P(null>=8)=0.23; P(null>=4 negative)=0.37). Groups clearing nc>=150, z>1.96, both start halves >0 and close_ok>0: price .45-.48, PASSED, time <2h (null mean 3.7, P(>=3)=0.25); clearly negative on the same bar: first listed 6-24h out and hidden (170 closes, -0.92, z=-2.07, T1 -0.51/T2 -1.37). Top 2/3-way: EV>=2.5% & shown +1.76 (139 closes), PROP & EV>=2.5% +1.67 (130 closes, 33 games), PROP & EV>=2.5% & shown +1.69 (126), books 6-9 & available<$100 +1.30 (101 closes, T2 only +0.56), NFL & EV>=2.5% +1.38 (107 closes, 15 games). Named pairs: kind x league: PROP|NHL +2.54 [+1.46,+3.74] (33 closes, 17 games), PROP|NFL -0.10 (414), TOTAL|NFL +0.03 (40); kind x EV: PROP|EV>=2.5 +1.67 (130), PROP|EV1-2.5 -0.26 (193), PROP|EV<1 -0.72 (154), SPREAD|EV<1 +0.84 [+0.06,+1.67] (46 closes; 31 of the 66 spread closes are ESPN/DraftKings closes); kind x timing: PROP|<2h +1.89, PROP|2-6h +1.14, PROP|6-24h -0.43 (321 closes); price x timing: .48-.50 | 6-24h -1.01 [-2.17,0.00] (142 closes, 19 games) vs .48-.50 | <2h +1.30 (43). All tables are in 'tables'.
findings.effect: no scan group beats chance except time-to-start groups (p_adj 0.003) and NHL (p_adj 0.01)
findings.luck_risk: About 800 looks at 683 closes in 69 games: expect about 40 nominal 5% hits. Only timing and NHL clear the family-wise bar; EV is a pre-specified linear effect.

findings.claim: ROI cannot rank groups at this sample size and disagrees with CLV where it looks strong.
findings.evidence: Of 61 one-way groups with >=100 settled bets, 3 have a 95% game-clustered ROI CI off zero: American +100..+104 (+11.9% [+1.1,+24.0], CLV -0.20), cnoBooks 8-9 (+15.9% [+4.3,+27.4], CLV +0.96), cnoBooks 10-11 (+21.2% [+7.6,+34.9], CLV -0.08): the 5% false-positive rate gives about 3. Correlation of group ROI with group CLV 0.06 (52 groups with >=30 closes); with listed EV -0.09. ROI by listed EV band: <1.5% +2.74%, 1.5-2.5% +0.49%, 2.5-4% -3.81%, 4-6% -3.54% (all CIs +-13 to +-25 points).
findings.effect: overall ROI +1.58% [-2.0, +6.4]; no group ROI is reliable
findings.luck_risk: ROI differences are noise: SD of one unit bet is about 1, so 250 bets give +-6 points.

findings.claim: Replication check: this analysis reproduces the phone's own splits exactly; differences are band-edge definitions only.
findings.evidence: Compared bets, closes, CLV, games and beat% for kind (7), sport (7), league (8), EV bands (6), odds bands (6), books behind the fair (8), agree share (4), sharp veto (4), available (4), shown/hidden screens (4), 10 markets: closes identical except 1 (odds band edge); CLV within 0.016 points; the phone's '+101 to +200' and '-150 to +100' band edges differ from mine by 16 bets; my CI half-widths are 0.97x the phone's median.
findings.effect: 68 splits compared; max CLV difference 0.016 pts

app_changes_implied: PROPOSAL (question for Tj, a TIGHTENING): raise the CNO list's minimum edge and the alert floor from 1% to 2.5% for bets first listed more than 6 hours before the start (data/scanner/Presets.kt: cnoFilters = CnoFilters(... minEv = 0.01 ...) in the built-in VOLUME preset; its alertMinEv is already 0.025). Evidence: EV<2.5% and >6h out is 982 bets (47% of all) with CLV -0.83% [-1.75,+0.03] on 347 closes in 31 games (negative, but the CI just reaches 0), both start halves negative (-0.16 / -1.67) while EV>=2.5% overall is +1.73% [+0.58,+3.07] (144 closes, 39 games). On the app's shown list that group is 337 bets (149 a day) with CLV -0.59% [-1.83,+0.46] on 170 closes in 23 games (negative but not clear on its own); with the hidden wide-read finds it is 982 bets (435 a day). Raising the floor at all times would take the shown list from 803 bets (356 a day) to 242 (107 a day). The auto-bet already floors at 2.5% (autoBetMinEv in the same file; the study's own rules line says edge >= 2.5% for the auto-bet, CNO edge >= 1%, alerts >= 4%), so this changes what Tj sees, not what is auto-placed. Number to settle it: about 340 closes in about 90 games with EV>=2.5% would pin the effect to +-0.5.

PROPOSAL (question, a TIGHTENING only if Tj wants it): a timing-aware edge floor on the auto-bet: keep 2.5% for bets first listed >6h out and do NOT lower it inside 6h on this evidence alone (EV<2.5% bets within 6h still beat the close at +0.88% [+0.52,+1.37] on 192 closes, but that is a decision about loosening a floor and belongs to Tj; it is stated as data, not as a recommendation).

PROPOSAL (question, thin evidence): consider an odds floor tighter than -200 for the auto-bet (data/scanner/Presets.kt: autoBetMinOdds = -200 in VOLUME), for example -120 (cost .545). Evidence: cost >= .55 bets are -1.02% [-1.98,+0.24] (64 closes, 27 games, beat the close 39%), controlled z=-2.6; but the closes for favourites are mostly Novig's own trades, and 150 favourite closes (about 90 more) with a Pinnacle/ESPN close would settle it. This only removes bets.

NO CHANGE SUGGESTED on the sharp veto (data/scanner/SharpVeto.kt), the book-count and agreeing rules (autoBetBooks/autoBetTwoSided in Presets.kt) or CNO's minBooks: PASSED vs VETOED is +0.90 [-0.44,+2.12] (153 vs 58 closes) and vanishes after EV control; more books is not better (slope +0.02 pts per book); agreement share adds nothing after EV. Keep all safety limits as they are; this data neither supports loosening nor proves they help.

NO CHANGE SUGGESTED on stake sizing by available dollars: CLV is flat across $25 to $2000+ (liquidity-weighted +0.21 [-0.35,+0.80] vs +0.19), so there is no CLV reason to size or filter by available beyond the practical fill limit.

LEAD ONLY (do not change anything yet): NHL (+1.69%, 69 closes, 19 games, probable preseason). If NHL is live next week, pre-register 'NHL props with EV>=1%' as a tagged study group in data/src/main/kotlin/com/tjshea/vigilant/data/study/ScanStudy.kt and test it on the next file; 100 closes in 40+ games would settle it.

STUDY FILE ONLY (no app behaviour): add a 'listed within 6h of start' and a 'close source' column to the READ ME's printed splits so the phone's own summary stops pooling early and late bets and ESPN/Novig-trades closes; every split in this file is confounded by them (data/src/main/kotlin/com/tjshea/vigilant/data/study/StudyExport.kt).
next_logging: Log a Novig-last-trades or Novig mid close (with its number of trades) for EVERY listed bet, not only Tj's and not only the last half hour, plus Pinnacle's prop close from ParlayAPI where it exists: today 1397 of 2080 bets (67%) have no close, 843 of them props, and the CLV of props is measured against Novig's own price, which confounds close source with kind.

Re-export after Oct 12 (or after 7+ game days) so the 376 open and 1397 no-close bets fill in; the second date half has only 65 closes. Target at least 300 games with a close and 2,000 closes: that gives a game-clustered CI about half as wide as today's (+-0.55 on the whole sample).

Run the book-page read (the 'green check') on EVERY bet with EV >= 1.5% at first look, not the top ~10 of each scan: today 314 of 2080 bets (15%) have agreeShare, booksAgreeing and a sharp verdict, all of them top-EV rows, so those attributes cannot be tested without selection. A random 20% of the rest would give a control.

Re-price every listed bet at fixed times before the start (about T-6h, T-2h, T-30m, T-5m) with its EV and `available`, not only on change: the timing effect (+1.41% within 6h vs -0.54% beyond) is the largest single effect here and cannot be separated from attributes without it.
Record depth at the price: dollars available at 1, 2 and 3 cents worse than the first-listed price, and the age of that book; `available` is the top level only and 70% of bets carry under $200.
Record a game-type flag (preseason / regular season / playoff) and the lineup status of the player for props: the NHL result may be preseason lineup news.

Log the CNO fair's age and the count of sharp books in the fair on every look (cnoListAgeSec exists only at first look) so 'stale fair' can be separated from 'real edge'; and store the devig method used for every row.
Print the share of bets per close source inside every printed split (the phone's splits already print the closes count but not the mix).
